native_mechanisms: One fold per mark, each fold's angle determined jointly by the mark and the preceding crease (state-chained, order-dependent absorption).
Every crease is gauged against all four wire birds' beaks at once and refolded tighter until all four agree — four coupled views of one crease, never four independent partial folds.
Thin the whole folded wad down to one small dense coin at the water's edge and discard every scrap, offcut, and failed reading so only the coin survives.
core_technique: SipHash-style 4-word ARX permutation (SipRound) used as an all-to-all coupling of a 256-bit state, absorbing 32-byte blocks with pre- and post-XOR of the message words, then 3 finalization rounds, lane XOR-fold, and MurmurHash3 fmix64.
